content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Masters in Chemistry or Biochemistry or Microbiology or Diary Chemistry, or Food Technology, Food and Nutrition or Bachelor of Technology in Diary/Oil or degree in Veterinary Sciences from Government recognized university having minimum 3(three) years of relevant experience. Experience required: Minimum 3 years of relevant experience. Age limit: Not more than 40 years and not less than 21 years. Pay: Rs. 50,000 per month. Qualification required: B.Sc. with major / honours in Chemistry or Biochemistry or Microbiology or Diary Chemistry or Agriculture Science or Animal Science or Fisheries Science or Biotechnology or Food Safety or Food Technology, Food and Nutrition or Diary Technology or Oil Technology or Veterinary Sciences. Age limit: Not more than 40 years and not less than 21 years. Pay: Rs. 30,000 per month. Qualification required: Graduate in any discipline from Government recognized university with 1 year diploma / certificate of Computer Applications having proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office, the internet and Email Services etc. Age limit: Not more than 40 years and not less than 21 years. Pay: Rs. 18,000 per month.
